reviews.author: Preparation ice bucket
reviews.text: This is the first store that mentions that they looked at the products. I didn't hit it or throw it, but I looked at the thickness of the pad on the Magic Keyboard and said that it was designed to go in slightly when I pressed the pogo pin on the Magic Keyboard, so I tried pressing it with my hand to see if it would go in easily, but it came up and said, "Why are you pressing it?" I was dumbfounded when I saw him speak so bluntly. If it breaks when you lightly press it with your hand, it will break every time you attach the iPad in the first place. It is a pogo pin method that connects by physically touching... It wasn't that I was looking down on people, I was just leaving, but I was so offended that I went back to ask, and there was someone else there, so I left alone. I know you can say it from the store clerk's point of view, but the words are different, and they say, "If you press that part, it may break, so please refrain from doing so," and they all come up and say, "Why are you pressing it?" This is different from asking bluntly. I wonder if he usually talks to customers that way. I left it for you to look at. If you want to save it, put it in. Why did you archive it? If you're a store clerk, be careful what you say.

reviews.author: Ganglin
reviews.text: Naver doesn't let you write a review without a receipt. The service was so bad that I didn't spend anything, so are you flattered? I'll say everything I have to say here. Yeongdeungpo and Yeouido are polar opposites. Yeouido is uncomfortably friendly, and here it makes real people uncomfortable. Like Yeouido, the service is thorough, greets you with a good greeting, and greets you with a smile. This is definitely not what I expect. At least when the customer looks at the item, he or she gives a choice that should not cause inconvenience. I was interested in the Magic Keyboard, so I looked around and said, “Why don’t you press it? If you press it, it will break.” Live, live… Anyone who sees it will think you're scratching it with a cutter knife. I've been to many direct Apple stores, but this is the first time I've been treated like this. I'll never go to Yeongdeungpo again... I was disappointed and went straight to Apple in Yeouido. I was looking at the same thing, but an employee came and asked if I was interested in an iPad. Starting from the beginning, this is a magic keyboard and how it is connected with a pogo pin and a detailed explanation is given... Isn’t this normal when a customer looks at the product?! They were so kind that I actually felt healed here. In Yeongdeungpo, no matter what the customer is interested in, they just stand there blankly and touch it to take a look. Why do they come to you and press the button? Hahaha. I don't even buy what I was planning to buy and just leave. I don't know if it's the short-haired clerk or the store manager, but think about it carefully as you work in service. I don't ever want to be overly friendly. Don't pick on customers and make them uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Baekho Kang
reviews.text: Why are you pressing it? Why are you clicking? Why are you pressing it? The more I think about asking again, the more absurd it becomes... . YouTubers have also posted a lot of reviews while trying to press the pogo pin. Even if you gently press it with your finger a hundred times, it is not a part that breaks. Why are you asking why I am pressing it? What is your intention? You could have pressed it while looking at the product, but would you have pressed it on purpose so that it would break? Did you click it after looking at it? What is the purpose of asking this obvious question? Is it normal to ask something like this? Are people funny? Are you trying to start a fight? No, it's ridiculous. Haha. Come to your senses and work. I won't hold back next time. You'll have all sorts of experiences in life.

reviews.author: onei __
reviews.text:
I visited this place while looking for a Chinese restaurant with a nice atmosphere near the express bus terminal.
The private room was well-equipped, making it a good place for quiet gatherings or year-end appointments, and the interior was clean and luxurious.
The broth of the gultangmyeon was light and had a deep flavor, so it was easy to eat, and the freshwater eel rice bowl had a generous portion of eel and went well with the rice.
Although it was a bit pricey, I was satisfied considering the food quality and space.
I recommend this Chinese restaurant for important occasions or family gatherings.

Mom likes it

reviews.author: Chanseul
reviews.text:
It rained on the first day of my trip to Seoul, so I had to eat lunch near the express bus terminal.
While thinking about where to go, I went to The First Seoraehyang One Bailey, which is recommended as a room restaurant for year-end group gatherings in Banpo.
At The First Seoraehyang One Bailey, you can enjoy hot and delicious Chinese food cooked to order using fresh ingredients delivered the same day.
Since it is within walking distance from the Express Bus Terminal, I recommend it as a private Chinese restaurant for a year-end gathering at the Express Bus Terminal.
I am very satisfied with the oyster jjamppong, japchaebap, and grilled dumplings, all of which have excellent food quality and reasonable prices!
I recommend The First Seoraehyang One Bailey, a room restaurant for year-end group dinners in Banpo, as it has not only hall seating but also room seating.

I ordered oyster noodle, a seasonal menu item, and was impressed by the refreshing yet rich taste of the oyster soup, and the sweet and sour pork inside.

The existing BHC fried the chicken after ordering (it took about 10 minutes), but here it was served right after ordering (it appears to have been fried in advance), but I was disappointed as it tasted very different from the Mom's Touch I was used to.

reviews.author: Julian Walker
reviews.text: Friendly staff and delicious burgers. It's a step above your typical fast food restaurant, and the warm and friendly service made the visit even more special. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a delicious chicken burger in Seoul!

reviews.text:
I visited during the March 1st holiday.
The price was 78,000 won, and it was so satisfying that it was comparable to most hotel buffets that cost 150,000 won.

I arrived early and the doors opened at 11:30 am so I waited and entered.
Parking is free for 3 hours, and meal time is 2 hours based on admission.

There were so many different types of food.
✔ Lamb, steak, sushi, raw fish, snow crab, seasoned crab, soy sauce crab, raw beef, and japchae were all delicious!
There were many other menu items, but I was full so I only ate a little bit, but nothing was particularly good.

The dessert was also great.
✔ The fruits were diverse, including grapes, pineapples, apples, and oranges.
✔ Americano and latte were also delicious.
✔ I don't usually eat a lot of desserts, but I was satisfied with everything, including chocolate with pistachios, chocolate pudding, green tea ice cream, and chocolate ice cream. There were more desserts, but I couldn't try them all.
